name: io.github.cloudlabworks/mcp-failure-lab
title: MCP Failure Lab
description: Deliberately faulty MCP server for testing how agent clients handle tool errors and disconnects.

environmentVariables.name: LAB_SCENARIO
environmentVariables.description: Fault to inject: healthy, tool-error, transient-error, delay, malformed, or disconnect

environmentVariables.name: LAB_DELAY_MS
environmentVariables.description: Delay in milliseconds for the delay scenario (0 to 10000)

environmentVariables.name: LAB_FAILURES
environmentVariables.description: Failing calls before success for the transient-error scenario (0 to 10)
